en.t: The warlord Zhu Quanzhong kills Emperor Zhaozong, the penultimate emperor of the Tang dynasty, after seizing control of the imperial government
en.s: Emperor Taizu of Later Liang (後梁太祖), personal name Zhu Quanzhong (朱全忠) (December 5, 852 – July 18, 912), né Zhu Wen (朱溫), name later changed to Zhu Huang (朱晃), nickname Zhu San (朱三, literally, "the third Zhu"), was a Chinese military general, monarch, and politician. He was a Jiedushi (military governor) and warlord who in 907 overthrew the Tang dynasty and established the Later Liang dynasty, ruling as its first emperor, ushering in the era of the Five Dynasties and Ten Kingdoms.

zh.t: 军阀朱全忠杀害唐昭宗
zh.s: 后梁太祖朱全忠（852年12月5日—912年7月18日），原名朱温，后改名朱晃，绰号朱三，是中国将领、君主和政治人物。他曾任节度使，是一名军阀；907年，他推翻唐朝并建立后梁，成为开国皇帝，开启五代十国时期。

en.t: Battle of Mieszko I against Wichmann the Younger and the Wolinians
en.s: The battle of Mieszko I against Wichmann the Younger and the Wolinians (Polish: Bitwa Mieszka I z Wichmanem Młodszym i Wolinianami; German: Schlacht von Mieszko I. gegen Wichmann den Jüngeren und die Wolliner) was fought during the Polish–Veletian War, on either 21 or 22 September 967, between the forces of the Duchy of Poland and the Duchy of Bohemia, led by duke Mieszko I, against the forces of the Confederacy of the Veleti and the tribe of Wolinians, led by count Wichmann the Younger.

zh.t: 梅什科一世对阵小维希曼及沃利尼亚人的战役
zh.s: 967年波兰—韦莱蒂战争期间，波兰公国与波希米亚公国联军和韦莱蒂联盟及沃利尼亚部族交战。前者由梅什科一世公爵率领，后者由伯爵小维希曼率领。战斗发生日期可能是9月21日或22日。

en.s: The Crusade of 1197, also known as the Crusade of Henry VI (German: Kreuzzug Heinrichs VI.) or the German Crusade (Deutscher Kreuzzug), was a crusade launched by the Hohenstaufen emperor Henry VI in response to the aborted attempt of his father, Emperor Frederick I, during the Third Crusade in 1189–90. Thus the military campaign is also known as the "Emperor's Crusade" (echoing the name "Kings' Crusade" given to the Third Crusade).

en.s: Toulouse was besieged from 22 September 1217 to 25 July 1218 during the Albigensian Crusade. It was the third of a series of sieges of the city during the height of Crusader efforts to put down Catharism (and the local Languedocian nobility). It ended in the repulsion of the Crusaders and the death of their leader, Simon IV de Montfort.

zh.s: 阿尔比十字军期间，图卢兹自1217年9月22日起遭围攻，直至1218年7月25日。这是十字军鼎盛时期为镇压卡特里派及当地朗格多克贵族而对该城发动的一系列围城战中的第三次。最终，十字军被击退，其领袖西蒙四世·德·蒙福尔阵亡。

en.s: The Battle of Saule (Lithuanian: Saulės mūšis / Šiaulių mūšis; German: Schlacht von Schaulen; Latvian: Saules kauja) was fought on 22 September 1236, between the Livonian Brothers of the Sword and pagan troops of Samogitians and Semigallians. Between 48 and 60 knights were killed, including the Livonian Master, Volkwin. It was the earliest large-scale defeat suffered by the orders in Baltic lands.

zh.s: 绍莱战役于1236年9月22日爆发，交战双方是宝剑骑士团与萨莫吉希亚人和塞米加利亚人组成的异教徒军队。48至60名骑士阵亡，其中包括利沃尼亚大师沃尔奎因。这是骑士团在波罗的海地区遭遇的最早一次大规模败仗。

en.s: The War of Saint-Sardos was a short war fought between the Kingdom of England and the Kingdom of France in 1324 during which the French invaded the English Duchy of Aquitaine. The war was a clear defeat for the English and led indirectly to the overthrow of Edward II of England. It can also be seen as one of the precursors to the Hundred Years' War.

en.s: The Battle of Araviana was a cavalry action fought during the War of the Two Peters on 22 September 1359. Eight hundred Aragonese horse, many of them Castilian exiles in service of the Crown of Aragon under Henry of Trastámara, had launched a cavalgada in Castilian territory when, near the Castilian town of Ágreda, confronted and routed a Castilian force under Juan Fernández de Henestrosa set to guard the frontier. Numerous Castilian noblemen and knights were killed, including Henestrosa, while many other were captured.

zh.s: 1359年9月22日，两彼得战争期间发生了阿拉维亚纳骑兵战。特拉斯塔马拉的亨利麾下有800名阿拉贡骑兵，其中许多是流亡的卡斯蒂利亚人。他们突袭卡斯蒂利亚境内，在阿格雷达附近遇上负责守卫边境、由胡安·费尔南德斯·德·埃内斯特罗萨率领的卡斯蒂利亚部队，并将其击溃。许多卡斯蒂利亚贵族和骑士阵亡，包括埃内斯特罗萨；另有许多人被俘。

en.s: The siege of Harfleur (18 August – 22 September 1415) was conducted by the English army of King Henry V in Normandy, France, during the Hundred Years' War. The defenders of Harfleur surrendered to the English on terms and were treated as prisoners of war. It was the first time that an English army made significant use of gunpowder artillery in the siege of a large urban settlement.

en.s: The Treaty of Basel of 22 September 1499 was an armistice following the Battle of Dornach, concluding the Swabian War, fought between the Swabian League and the Old Swiss Confederacy. Though the war had concluded in multiple Swiss victories, both Switzerland and the Swabian League were exhausted, and the leaders of both sides desired peace. The two sides would meet in Basel to agree to terms of peace.

zh.s: 1499年9月22日，施瓦本战争结束后，施瓦本同盟与旧瑞士邦联在巴塞尔签署停战协定。战争以瑞士多次获胜告终，但双方都已疲惫，领导人希望恢复和平，最终在巴塞尔商定条款。

en.s: The Swabian War of 1499 (Alemannic German: Schwoobechrieg; spelling depending on dialect), called Schwabenkrieg or Schweizerkrieg ("Swiss War") in Germany and Engadiner Krieg ("War of the Engadin") in Austria, was the last major armed conflict between the Old Swiss Confederacy and the House of Habsburg. What had begun as a local conflict over the control of the Val Müstair and the Umbrail Pass in the Grisons soon got out of hand when both parties called upon their allies for help; the Habsburgs demanding the support of the Swabian League, while the Federation of the Three Leagues of the Grisons turned to the Swiss Eidgenossenschaft. Hostilities quickly spread from the Grisons through the Rhine valley to Lake Constance and even to the Sundgau in southern Alsace, the westernmost part of the Habsburg region of Further Austria. Many battles were fought from January to July 1499, and in all but a few minor skirmishes, the experienced Swiss soldiers defeated the Swabian and Habsburg armies. After their victories in the Burgundian Wars, the Swiss had battle tested troops and commanders. On the Swabian side, distrust between the knights and their foot soldiers, disagreements amongst the military leadership, and a general reluctance to fight a war that even the Swabian counts considered to be more in the interests of the powerful Habsburgs than in the interest of the Holy Roman Empire proved fatal handicaps. When his military high commander fell in the battle of Dornach, where the Swiss won a final decisive victory, Emperor Maximilian I had no choice but to agree to a peace treaty signed on September 22, 1499, in Basel.

zh.s: 1499年施瓦本战争是旧瑞士邦联与哈布斯堡王朝之间最后一场大规模武装冲突，在德国称“施瓦本战争”或“瑞士战争”，在奥地利称“恩加丁战争”。冲突起初围绕格劳宾登的瓦尔·米斯泰尔和乌姆布赖尔山口控制权展开，随后双方都召集盟友参战：哈布斯堡要求施瓦本同盟出兵，格劳宾登三联盟则向瑞士邦联求援。战事迅速从格劳宾登蔓延到莱茵河谷、博登湖，甚至扩展到南阿尔萨斯的松德高地区。1499年1月至7月间发生多场战斗，经验丰富的瑞士军队几乎在所有交战中都击败了施瓦本和哈布斯堡军队。瑞士人在勃艮第战争后拥有久经战阵的部队和指挥官；施瓦本方面则受骑士与步兵互不信任、军事领导层意见不合，以及普遍不愿为哈布斯堡利益而战等问题拖累。多尔纳赫战役中，瑞士取得决定性胜利，神圣罗马帝国皇帝马克西米利安一世失去最高军事指挥官，只得同意于1499年9月22日在巴塞尔签订和约。

en.s: The Battle of Zutphen was fought on 22 September 1586, near the village of Warnsveld and the town of Zutphen, the Netherlands, during the Eighty Years' War. It was fought between forces of the United Provinces of the Netherlands, aided by the English, against the Spanish. In 1585, England signed the Treaty of Nonsuch with the States-General of the Netherlands and formally entered the war against Spain. Robert Dudley, Earl of Leicester, was appointed as the Governor-General of the Netherlands and sent there in command of an English army to support the Dutch rebels.

zh.s: 聚特芬战役于1586年9月22日在荷兰聚特芬镇及附近的瓦恩斯费尔德村一带爆发，属于八十年战争。尼德兰联省共和国军队在英军协助下与西班牙军队交战。1585年，英格兰与尼德兰总督议会签署《诺恩苏奇条约》，正式参战反对西班牙。莱斯特伯爵罗伯特·达德利被任命为尼德兰总督，率领一支英军前往支援荷兰起义军。

The French settlement of Cayenne under the French Governor Lefebvre de Lézy was captured in an assault by English sailors and troops of Rear Admiral Sir John Harman's squadron. The English then occupied the settlement stripping it of anything of value before departing two weeks later. zh.s: 卡宴战役是第二次英荷战争末期的一场小规模军事行动，发生于1667年9月22日。法国总督勒费弗尔·德·莱齐统治下的卡宴殖民地遭到英国海军上将约翰·哈曼爵士中将舰队的水兵和士兵袭击并攻占。英军随后占领该地，掠走有价值的物资，两周后离开。

en.s: The Battle of Sednev is an episode of the Left-Bank uprising of the Zaporozhian Cossacks against the Russian Tsardom. Hetman Demian Mnohohrishny, appointed by Petro Doroshenko at the head of the Seversk regiments, stood in September 1668 with an army near Sednev, while the Russian army led by Grigory Romodanovsky assaulted Chernihiv.

zh.s: 塞德涅夫战役是左岸哥萨克反抗俄罗斯沙皇国起义中的一场战斗。1668年9月，彼得罗·多罗申科任命季米扬·姆诺霍里什内统领谢韦尔斯克军团；他率军驻扎在塞德涅夫附近，而格里戈里·罗莫达诺夫斯基率领的俄军则进攻切尔尼戈夫。

en.s: The Naval battle off St. John took place on 22 September 1691 between France and England toward the beginning of King William's War in the Bay of Fundy off present-day Saint John, New Brunswick. The English ship sailed with the new British Governor of Acadia Edward Tyng while the French ship sailed with the French Governor of Acadia Joseph Robineau de Villebon.

zh.s: 1691年9月22日，威廉王之战初期，法国与英国在芬迪湾、今加拿大新不伦瑞克省圣约翰附近海域交战。英国舰船搭载新任阿卡迪亚总督爱德华·廷格，法国舰船则搭载阿卡迪亚总督约瑟夫·罗比诺·德·维尔邦。

en.s: The Battle of Rio de Janeiro was a raid in September 1711 on the port of Rio de Janeiro in the War of Spanish Succession by a French squadron under René Duguay-Trouin. The Portuguese defenders, including the city's governor and an admiral of the fleet anchored there, were unable to put up effective resistance in spite of numerical advantages and the city had to pay a ransom to avoid destruction of its defences.

en.t: Coronation of George III and Charlotte
en.s: The coronation of George III and his wife Charlotte as king and queen of Great Britain and Ireland took place at Westminster Abbey, London, on Tuesday, 22 September 1761, about two weeks after they were married in the Chapel Royal, St James's Palace. The day was marked by errors and omissions; a delayed procession from Westminster Hall to the abbey was followed by a six-hour coronation service and then a banquet that finally ended at ten o'clock at night.

zh.t: 乔治三世与夏洛特加冕典礼
zh.s: 1761年9月22日星期二，乔治三世和妻子夏洛特在伦敦威斯敏斯特教堂加冕为大不列颠及爱尔兰国王与王后。两人约两周前在圣詹姆斯宫皇家礼拜堂举行婚礼。典礼当天状况频出：从威斯敏斯特大厅前往教堂的仪仗队迟到，加冕仪式持续了6小时，之后的宴会直到晚上10点才结束。

en.s: Nathan Hale (June 6, 1755 – September 22, 1776) was an American Patriot, soldier, and spy for the Continental Army during the American Revolutionary War. He volunteered for an intelligence-gathering mission in New York City but was captured by the British and executed. Hale is considered an American hero and in 1985 was officially designated the state hero of Connecticut.

zh.s: 内森·黑尔（1755年6月6日—1776年9月22日）是美国独立战争期间的爱国者、士兵和大陆军间谍。他自愿前往纽约市执行情报任务，被英军俘虏后处决。黑尔被视为美国英雄，康涅狄格州于1985年正式将他列为州英雄。

en.s: The Battle of the Urup River, also known as the Battle of Jilehoy, was a confrontation between Russian troops led by General Maxim Rebinder and Circassian, Abazin and Nogai fighters led by Sheikh Mansur. Although victorious at first, after the arrival of Russian reinforcements, Mansur and his fighters were forced to retreat.

en.t: The office of United States Postmaster General is established
en.s: The United States postmaster general (PMG) is the chief executive officer of the United States Postal Service (USPS). The PMG is responsible for managing and directing the day-to-day operations of the agency. The PMG is selected and appointed by the Board of Governors of the Postal Service, which is appointed by the president. The postmaster general then also sits on the board.

zh.t: 美国邮政总局局长职位设立
zh.s: 美国邮政总局局长（PMG）是美国邮政署（USPS）的首席执行官，负责管理和指导该机构日常运作。邮政总局局长由邮政署董事会选任并任命；董事会成员由总统任命。局长随后也成为董事会成员。

en.s: The Battle of Falmagne (French: Bataille de Falmagne, Dutch: Slag bij Falmagne) was fought during the Brabant Revolution between the Holy Roman Empire and the United Belgian States on 22 September 1790. A volunteer force of 5,000 Belgian revolutionaries with four cannons, led by General George Koehler, crossed the river Maas at Moniat on 22 September 1790 to attack the heights of Anseremme and Falmagne.

zh.s: 1790年9月22日，布拉班特革命期间，神圣罗马帝国与比利时合众国在法尔马涅交战。乔治·科勒将军率领5,000名比利时革命志愿军和4门火炮，于当天在莫尼亚特渡过默兹河，进攻昂瑟雷姆和法尔马涅的高地。

en.s: The Battle of Saint-Fulgent (22 September 1793) saw Royalist and Republican French forces clash at Saint-Fulgent during the War in the Vendée. The 11,000 Vendean rebels led by Henri de La Rochejaquelein defeated a 6,000-man Republican division commanded by Jean Quirin de Mieszkowski belonging to the Army of the Coasts of La Rochelle. Half of the Republican force was killed, wounded or captured while rebel losses were only one-tenth as high. In mid-September the Republican Army of the Coasts of La Rochelle led by Jean Antoine Rossignol advanced into the Vendée from the south and east while the Army of the Coasts of Brest and the Army of Mainz under Jean Baptiste Camille Canclaux advanced from the west.

zh.s: 1793年9月22日，旺代战争期间，保王党和共和派法国军队在圣富尔让交战。昂利·德·拉罗什雅克兰率领的11,000名旺代叛军击败了让·基兰·德·米什科夫斯基指挥的6,000人共和军师。共和军半数士兵被杀、受伤或被俘；叛军损失约为其十分之一。9月中旬，拉罗谢尔海岸军由让-安托万·罗西尼奥尔率领，从南部和东部进入旺代；布雷斯特海岸军和美因茨军则在让-巴蒂斯特·卡米耶·康克洛指挥下从西面推进。

en.s: The Battle of Truillas was fought on 22 September 1793 during the French Revolutionary War between the French Army of the eastern Pyrenees led by Luc Siméon Auguste Dagobert and the Spanish Army of Catalonia under Antonio Ricardos. This attempt by the French to exploit their success in the Battle of Peyrestortes ended in a Spanish victory. Part of the War of the Pyrenees, the battle was fought near the village of Trouillas in the French department of Pyrénées Orientales, 12 km southwest of Perpignan.

zh.s: 1793年9月22日，法国大革命战争期间，吕西·西蒙·奥古斯特·达戈贝尔率领的法国东比利牛斯军团与安东尼奥·里卡多斯指挥的西班牙加泰罗尼亚军团交战。法军试图扩大战果，重演佩雷斯托尔特战役的胜利，但最终败给西班牙军队。这场战斗属于比利牛斯战争，发生在法国东比利牛斯省的特鲁亚村附近，距佩皮尼昂西南约12公里。

en.s: The Paraguay campaign (1810-1811) was a military expedition launched by Buenos Aires and commanded by Manuel Belgrano to ensure the adherence of the Intendency of Paraguay to the Primera Junta, which was established after the May Revolution. It is considered both a part of the independence of Argentina and Paraguay. The first battles fought were the Battle of Campichuelo and Battle of Campo Maracana, in which the Junta of Buenos Aires army claimed victory.

zh.s: 巴拉圭战役（1810—1811年）是布宜诺斯艾利斯发起的一次军事远征，由曼努埃尔·贝尔格拉诺指挥，目的是促使巴拉圭省服从五月革命后成立的布宜诺斯艾利斯执政委员会。这场战役既被视为阿根廷独立战争的一部分，也被视为巴拉圭独立战争的一部分。双方最早交战于坎皮丘埃洛战役和坎波马拉卡纳战役，布宜诺斯艾利斯军队均宣称获胜。

en.t: The Russian warship Lefort capsizes and sinks during a storm in the Gulf of Finland, killing all 826 aboard
en.s: Lefort (Russian: Лефорт; also spelled "Leffort") was an Imperatritsa Aleksandra–class ship of the line of the Imperial Russian Navy, rated at 84 guns but actually armed with 94 guns. Her keel was laid in 1833 at Saint Petersburg and she was launched 9 August [O.S. 28 July] 1835 in the presence of Nicholas I. She was named after Admiral Franz Lefort, the head of the Russian Navy from 1695 to 1696.

zh.t: 俄罗斯战舰“列福尔特”号在芬兰湾风暴中倾覆沉没，826人全部遇难
zh.s: “列福尔特”号（俄语：Лефорт；亦拼作Leffort）是俄罗斯帝国海军亚历山德拉皇后级风帆战列舰，标称84门炮，实际装备94门。该舰于1833年在圣彼得堡铺设龙骨，1835年8月9日（儒略历7月28日）下水，当时尼古拉一世在场。舰名源自1695年至1696年俄罗斯海军首脑弗朗茨·列福尔特海军上将。

en.t: Lincoln issues the preliminary Emancipation Proclamation
en.s: President Abraham Lincoln announced that enslaved people in areas still in rebellion against the United States would be declared free on January 1, 1863. This preliminary Emancipation Proclamation gave advance notice of a wartime measure and linked Union military policy more explicitly to emancipation. It did not immediately free every enslaved person, nor did the final proclamation apply equally to all states and territories. Its practical effect depended heavily on the advance of Union forces. Nevertheless, the announcement changed the political meaning of the Civil War and prepared the way for the final proclamation issued at the start of the following year.

zh.t: 林肯发布《解放奴隶初步宣言》
zh.s: 1862年9月22日，美国总统亚伯拉罕·林肯宣布：仍在反叛美国的地区内的奴隶，将于1863年1月1日起获得自由。这份初步宣言提前公布了一项战时措施，也让联邦军的军事政策更明确地与废奴相连。它并没有立即解放所有奴隶，最终宣言的适用范围也不包括所有州和领地；实际效果很大程度上取决于联邦军的推进。不过，这一宣布改变了美国内战的政治意义，并为次年年初发布的正式宣言铺平了道路。

loc: 美国田纳西州沙利文县

en.s: The Battle of Blountville, sometimes called Battle of Blountsville, was a battle of the American Civil War, occurring on September 22, 1863, in Sullivan County, Tennessee. The battle occurred during a Union expedition into East Tennessee led by Major General Ambrose Burnside, commander of the Department of the Ohio, with the objective of clearing the roads and gaps to Virginia and securing the saltworks in southwestern Virginia. On September 22, Union Col. John W. Foster, with his cavalry and artillery, engaged Col. James E. Carter and his troops at Blountville.

zh.s: 布朗特维尔战役又称布朗茨维尔战役，于1863年9月22日在田纳西州沙利文县爆发，属于美国内战的一部分。安布罗斯·伯恩赛德少将率领联邦军远征东田纳西，目标是清理通往弗吉尼亚的道路和山口，并控制弗吉尼亚西南部的盐场。当天，约翰·W.福斯特上校率领骑兵和炮兵在布朗特维尔与詹姆斯·E.卡特上校及其部队交战。

en.s: The Battle of Jack's Shop was a cavalry engagement fought on September 22, 1863, by Union forces under John Buford and Hugh Kilpatrick and a Confederate division under J. E. B. Stuart during the American Civil War.

zh.s: 1863年9月22日，美国内战期间，约翰·布福德和休·基尔帕特里克率领的联邦骑兵与J. E. B.斯图尔特指挥的邦联骑兵师在杰克商店交战。

en.s: The Battle of Curupayty was a key battle in the Paraguayan War. On the morning of September 22, 1866, the joint force of Brazilian, Argentine, and Uruguayan armies attacked Paraguayan fortified trenches on Curupaity. The Paraguayans were led by General José E. Díaz. This position was held by 5,000 men and 49 cannons, some of them in hidden places out of the attackers view. The Brazilian Navy gave support to the 20,000 assailants, but the ships had to keep some distance from the guns at the fortress of Humaitá, which led to the lack of accuracy and impact of the ship's fire.

zh.s: 1866年9月22日上午，巴拉圭战争期间，巴西、阿根廷和乌拉圭联军共同进攻巴拉圭军队在库鲁帕伊蒂构筑的防御战壕。巴拉圭军由何塞·E.迪亚斯将军指挥，阵地上有5,000名士兵和49门火炮，其中一些藏在隐蔽位置。巴西海军为2万名进攻士兵提供支援，但舰艇不得不与乌迈塔要塞的火炮保持距离，导致舰炮射击不准、效果有限。

en.s: Das Rheingold (German: [das ˈʁaɪnɡɔlt] ; The Rhinegold), WWV 86A, is the first of the four epic music dramas that constitute Richard Wagner's cycle Der Ring des Nibelungen (English: The Ring of the Nibelung). It premiered as a single opera at the National Theatre of Munich on 22 September 1869, and received its first performance as part of the Ring cycle at the Bayreuth Festspielhaus on 13 August 1876.

zh.s: 《莱茵的黄金》（德语：Das Rheingold，WWV 86A）是理查德·瓦格纳《尼伯龙根的指环》四部音乐剧中的第一部。它于1869年9月22日在慕尼黑国家剧院作为独立歌剧首演，之后于1876年8月13日在拜罗伊特节日剧院首次作为《指环》套曲的一部分演出。

en.t: The first issue of the National Geographic Magazine was published on September 22, 1888, eight months after the Society was founded
en.s: National Geographic (formerly The National Geographic Magazine, sometimes branded as Nat Geo) is an American monthly magazine published by National Geographic Partners and is based in Washington, DC. The magazine was founded in 1888 as a scholarly journal, nine months after the establishment of the society, but is now a popular magazine. In 1905, it began including pictures, a style for which it became well known.

zh.s: 《国家地理》是美国月刊，由国家地理伙伴公司出版，总部位于华盛顿特区。该刊1888年创办时是学术期刊，创刊时间比国家地理学会成立晚9个月；如今已成为大众杂志。1905年起，杂志开始刊登照片，并以此闻名。

en.t: Queen Victoria surpasses her grandfather King George III as the longest reigning monarch in British history (later surpassed by her great-great-granddaughter Elizabeth II on 9 September 2015)
en.s: Victoria (Alexandrina Victoria; 24 May 1819 – 22 January 1901) was Queen of the United Kingdom of Great Britain and Ireland from 20 June 1837 until her death in 1901. Her reign of 63 years and 216 days, which was longer than those of any of her predecessors, constituted the Victorian era, a period of industrial, political, scientific, and military change within the United Kingdom marked by a great expansion of the British Empire.

zh.t: 维多利亚女王超越祖父乔治三世，成为英国历史上在位时间最长的君主
zh.s: 维多利亚女王本名亚历山德丽娜·维多利亚，生于1819年5月24日，卒于1901年1月22日。她自1837年6月20日起担任大不列颠及爱尔兰联合王国女王，直至1901年去世。在位63年216天，超过此前所有君主。她的统治时期被称为维多利亚时代，英国在工业、政治、科学和军事方面发生变化，大英帝国也大幅扩张。

en.t: The Duke of York's Picture House opens in Brighton, now the oldest continually operating cinema in Britain
en.s: The Duke of York's Picture House is an art house cinema in Brighton, England, which lays claim to being the oldest cinema in continuous use in Britain. According to cinema historian Allen Eyles, the cinema "deserves to be named Britain's oldest cinema". The cinema is a Grade II listed building.

zh.t: 约克公爵电影院在布莱顿开业，现为英国持续营业时间最长的电影院
zh.s: 约克公爵电影院是位于英格兰布莱顿的一家艺术影院，自称是英国持续营业时间最长的电影院。电影史学家艾伦·艾尔斯认为，这家影院“理应被称为英国最古老的电影院”。该建筑被列为二级保护建筑。

en.s: The Bombardment of Papeete occurred in French Polynesia when German warships attacked on 22 September 1914, during World War I. The German armoured cruisers SMS Scharnhorst and Gneisenau entered the port of Papeete on the island of Tahiti and sank the French gunboat Zélée and freighter Walkure before bombarding the town's fortifications. French shore batteries and a gunboat resisted the German intrusion, but were greatly outgunned.

zh.s: 第一次世界大战期间，德国军舰于1914年9月22日袭击法属波利尼西亚。装甲巡洋舰沙恩霍斯特号和格奈森瑙号驶入塔希提岛帕皮提港，击沉法国炮舰“泽莱号”和货轮“沃克吕尔号”，随后炮击镇上的防御工事。法国岸炮和炮舰奋起抵抗，但火力远不及德舰。

en.s: The Action of 22 September 1914 was an attack by the German U-boat U-9 that took place during the First World War. Three obsolete Royal Navy cruisers of the 7th Cruiser Squadron manned mainly by Royal Naval Reserve part-timers and sometimes referred to as the Live Bait Squadron, were sunk by U-9 while patrolling the southern North Sea.

zh.s: 第一次世界大战期间，德国U-9号潜艇于1914年9月22日发动袭击，在北海南部巡逻时击沉了皇家海军第七巡洋舰分舰队的三艘老旧巡洋舰。该分舰队多数成员是皇家海军预备役兼职人员，因此有时被称为“活诱饵分舰队”。

en.s: The bombardment of Madras was an engagement of the First World War, at Madras (now Chennai), British India. The bombardment was initiated by the German light cruiser Emden at the outset of the war in 1914. With Captain Karl von Müller in command, on the night of 22 September 1914, SMS Emden quietly approached the city of Madras on the southeastern coast of the Indian peninsula.

zh.s: 第一次世界大战期间，德国轻巡洋舰“埃姆登号”于1914年9月22日晚悄然接近英属印度东南海岸的马德拉斯（今金奈）。时任舰长卡尔·冯·米勒指挥这艘军舰发起了对马德拉斯的轰炸。

en.s: The Veresmart Offensive was a World War I military engagement between Romanian forces on one side and Central Powers forces (Germany and Austria-Hungary) on the other side. It was part of the larger Battle of Transylvania. Although the Romanians failed to reach their planned objective, the strategic situation of the Central Powers was significantly worsened by the Romanian attack. Nevertheless, the Romanian forces did not exploit their strategic success further.

zh.s: 韦雷斯马尔特攻势是第一次世界大战期间的一场军事交战，罗马尼亚军队与德国、奥匈帝国组成的同盟国部队交战，属于更大规模的特兰西瓦尼亚战役。罗马尼亚未能实现预定目标，但其进攻显著恶化了同盟国的战略处境；不过，罗军没有进一步扩大这一战略优势。

en.s: The First Battle of Petrozsény was a military engagement fought between Romanian forces on one side and German forces on the other side. It was part of the 1916 Battle of Transylvania, itself part of the Romanian Campaign of World War I. This was a German attack which drove off the Romanian forces from the Transylvanian coal mining center of Petrozsény (the present-day city of Petroșani in Hunedoara County, Romania).

en.s: The Battle of Vulcan Pass took place on the Eastern Front of World War I. Vulcan Pass was captured by the Germans on 21 September during the retreat of the Romanians. The retreat occurred after the Romanian army was beaten near the city of Hermannstadt. However, on the following day, the Romanian units were still actively fighting against the advancing German troops.

en.s: The Battle of Flers–Courcelette ([flɛʁ kuʁsəlɛt], 15 to 22 September 1916) was fought during the Battle of the Somme in France, by the French Sixth Army and the British Fourth Army and Reserve Army, against the German 1st Army, during the First World War. The Anglo-French attack of 15 September began the third period of the Battle of the Somme but by its conclusion on 22 September, the strategic objective of a decisive victory had not been achieved.

en.s: The Capture of Jisr ed Damieh took place on 22 September 1918 during the Third Transjordan attack of the Battle of Nablus which, along with the main Battle of Sharon formed the Battle of Megiddo fought during the Sinai and Palestine Campaign of the First World War. Units of Chaytor's Force under the commanded by Brigadier-General William Meldrum, and known as "Meldrum's Force", attacked and captured the bridge.

zh.t: 夺取吉斯尔埃德达米耶桥
zh.s: 1918年9月22日，西奈及巴勒斯坦战役期间，查伊托尔部队在纳布卢斯战役中的第三次外约旦攻势中夺取了吉斯尔埃德达米耶桥。纳布卢斯战役与主要的沙龙战役共同构成米吉多战役。威廉·梅尔德鲁姆准将指挥这支部队，也因此称为“梅尔德鲁姆部队”。

en.s: The Great Steel Strike of 1919 was an attempt by the American Federation of Labor to organize United States Steel, the leading company in the American steel industry. The AFL formed a coalition of 24 unions, all of which had grown rapidly during World War I. In the lead role would be the Amalgamated Association of Iron, Steel and Tin Workers (AA) with a five-member steering committee. The strike began on September 22, 1919, and finally collapsed on January 8, 1920.

zh.s: 1919年美国钢铁大罢工是美国劳工联合会（AFL）试图组织美国钢铁公司工人的行动；该公司是美国钢铁业的龙头企业。AFL组织了24个工会组成联盟，这些工会在第一次世界大战期间都迅速壮大。主力是钢铁工人联合会（AA），并由五人委员会领导。罢工于1919年9月22日开始，最终在1920年1月8日失败。

en.s: The Rineen ambush was an ambush carried out by the Irish Republican Army (IRA) on 22 September 1920, during the Irish War of Independence. It took place at Drummin Hill in the townland of Drummin, near the hamlet of Rineen (or Rinneen), County Clare. The IRA's Mid-Clare Brigade attacked a Royal Irish Constabulary (RIC) lorry, killing six officers. Shortly after, the IRA volunteers were attacked by ten lorry-loads of British Army soldiers, who had been sent as reinforcements. However, they held off this attack long enough to flee the scene and sustained only two wounded.

zh.s: 1920年9月22日，爱尔兰独立战争期间，爱尔兰共和军（IRA）在克莱尔郡里内恩附近的德拉明镇地、德拉明山发动伏击，袭击一辆皇家爱尔兰警察队（RIC）卡车，打死6名警员。不久后，10车英国陆军增援部队赶到并攻击IRA志愿兵；他们顶住攻击一段时间后撤离，只有2人受伤。

en.s: The Gresford disaster (Welsh: Trychineb Gresffordd) occurred on 22 September 1934 at Gresford Colliery, near Wrexham, when an explosion and underground fire killed 261 men. Gresford is one of Britain's worst coal mining disasters: a controversial inquiry into the disaster did not conclusively identify a cause, though evidence suggested that failures in safety procedures and poor mine management were contributory factors.

zh.s: 1934年9月22日，威尔士雷克瑟姆附近的格雷斯福德煤矿发生爆炸并引发井下火灾，造成261名矿工死亡。这是英国最严重的煤矿灾难之一。备受争议的调查未能确定事故原因，但证据显示，安全程序失守和矿井管理不善可能是诱因。

en.s: The 1935 All-Ireland Senior Football Championship final was the 48th All-Ireland Final and the deciding match of the 1935 All-Ireland Senior Football Championship, an inter-county Gaelic football tournament for the top teams in Ireland. en.t: Sara Jane Moore tries to assassinate U.S. President Gerald Ford, but is foiled by the Secret Service
en.s: Sara Jane Moore (née Kahn; February 15, 1930 – September 24, 2025) was an American accountant and FBI informant who attempted to assassinate U.S. president Gerald Ford in 1975. Moore believed the attack would spark a violent revolution across the nation that would lead to the U.S. government being overthrown for how they handled the Vietnam War.

en.s: The Food and Drug Administration (FDA) is a federal agency of the United States Department of Health and Human Services (HHS). en.s: The Iran–Iraq War was an armed conflict between Iran and Ba'athist Iraq lasting from September 1980 to August 1988. The Iran–Iraq War began when Iraq invaded Iran on 22 September 1980. It followed a long history of border disputes, and was motivated by fears that the Iranian Revolution in 1979 would inspire insurgency among Iraq's long-suppressed Shi'i majority, as well as Iraq's desire to replace Iran as the dominant Persian Gulf state. Although Iraq hoped to take advantage of Iran's revolutionary chaos and attacked without formal warning, it made only limited progress into Iran and was quickly repelled; Iran regained virtually all lost territory by June 1982.

zh.s: 两伊战争是伊朗与复兴社会党的伊拉克之间的武装冲突，持续于1980年9月至1988年8月。战争于1980年9月22日爆发，伊拉克入侵伊朗。两国长期存在边境争端；伊拉克还担心伊朗革命会在其长期受压制的什叶派人口中引发叛乱，并希望取代伊朗成为波斯湾主导力量。伊拉克想趁伊朗革命后的混乱占得先机，在没有正式宣战的情况下发动进攻，但只在伊朗境内取得有限进展，很快遭到击退；到1982年6月，伊朗几乎收复全部失地。

en.s: W.A.K.O. European Championships 1984 were the seventh European kickboxing championships hosted by the W.A.K.O. organization arranged by Peter Land. The championships were open to amateur men based in Europe with each country allowed only one competitor per weight division, with the styles on offer being Full-Contact and Semi-Contact kickboxing. Regular European leaders West Germany were the top nation by the end of the championships, followed by Italy in second and hosts Austria in third. The event was held in Graz, Austria on Saturday, 22 September 1984.

en.s: The 1988 Hong Kong legislative election was an indirect election for members of the Legislative Council of Hong Kong (LegCo); was held on 22 September 1988. It was the second ever election of the Legislative Council in Hong Kong history based on the 1987 Review of Developments in Representative Government, as the Government's democratisation process according to the agreement of the Sino-British Joint Declaration. There were 12 members elected by Electoral Colleges, 14 members from functional constituencies. A total of 9,276 out of almost 17,000 registered votes turned to return 13 candidates in 8 electoral college and 4 functional constituency seats while another 13 seats were returned unopposed.

zh.s: 1988年香港立法局选举于1988年9月22日举行，是间接选举，选出香港立法局（LegCo）议员，也是香港历史上第二次立法局选举。选举依据1987年《代议制政府发展检讨》进行，属于《中英联合声明》框架下政府推动民主化进程的一部分。选举团选出12名议员，功能界别选出14名议员。约1.7万名登记选民中有9,276人投票；8个选举团和4个功能界别席位共选出13名候选人，另有13席自动当选。

en.s: The CMLL 62nd Anniversary Show was a professional wrestling major show event produced by Consejo Mundial de Lucha Libre (CMLL) that took place on September 22, 1995 in Arena México, Mexico City, Mexico. The show consisted of five matches, with the main event being a Lucha de Apuestas, hair vs. hair match, between Silver King and Miguel Perez Jr. The show also featured three Six-man tag team matches and a tag team match to open the show. The event commemorated the 62nd anniversary of CMLL, the oldest professional wrestling promotion in the world.

en.s: The Nagarkovil school bombing was an airstrike on 22 September 1995 in which the Sri Lankan Air Force bombed the Nagarkovil Maha Vidyalayam school in Jaffna in northern Sri Lanka, resulting in the death of, by varying accounts, 34-71 Sri Lankan Tamil civilians, primarily schoolchildren, and injuries to many more. Sri Lankan Defense spokesman admitted the incident but claimed that it was a LTTE facility and several of the dead were LTTE cadres.

en.s: The Gambian presidential election, 2006 was held on 22 September 2006. 670,000 Gambians registered to vote, and 59% of registered voters turned out to vote. Many of the 989 polling booths used marbles which were inserted into candidate drums instead of ballot papers due to the high illiteracy rate. The marble system is only used in Gambia, where it has been used since 1965. Yahya Jammeh was re-elected with 67.3% of the vote and was declared the winner of the election. Darboe, who received second place with 27% of the vote, rejected the official results, saying that the election was not free and fair and that there was widespread voter intimidation.

zh.s: 冈比亚于2006年9月22日举行总统选举。登记选民有670,000人，投票率为59%。由于识字率较低，989个投票站中有许多用弹珠代替选票：选民把弹珠投入候选人的投票筒。冈比亚自1965年以来一直采用这种方式。叶海亚·贾梅以67.3%的得票率连任；获得第二名、得票率为27%的达博拒绝接受官方结果，称选举不自由、不公平，并指存在大范围恐吓选民的情况。

This year's edition was a repeat of the Libyan Cup final of the previous season, which saw Ittihad Tripoli beat Tersanah on penalties. The match took place on September 22, 2009. Ittihad won their seventh consecutive Super Cup title 3-2, stretching back to 2002. It was played at the 11 June Stadium.

zh.s: 2009年利比亚超级杯是该赛事第13届。比赛重演了上一赛季的利比亚杯决赛，当时的黎波里伊蒂哈德队在点球大战中击败塔尔萨纳队。2009年9月22日，伊蒂哈德队以3比2取胜，在这场自2002年以来连续第7次夺冠的赛事中再度捧杯。比赛在六月十一日体育场举行。

en.s: A state election was held in Hesse on 22 September 2013, coinciding with the 2013 federal election. On 8 February 2013, Minister-President Volker Bouffier agreed to the proposal of the President Joachim Gauck to hold the state elections on the same day as Germany's federal elections. The official result gave no major parties and their traditional coalition partners a clear majority in the parliament. On 17 December, the CDU and the Greens announced a tentative coalition agreement, which was confirmed on 21 December, creating the second CDU-Green coalition to govern a German state, after the previous government of Hamburg.

en.s: The first local elections in the Democratic Federation of Northern Syria were held on 22 September 2017. en.s: The Osun State gubernatorial election took place on 22 September 2018. The election was held alone where national and state level elections were to be held by 2019. Two-term incumbent Governor Rauf Aregbesola of the All Progressives Congress was in-eligible to run for re-election. Ademola Adeleke of the People's Democratic Party won the initial election as announced by INEC. but was defeated in a rerun on 27 September by Gboyega Oyetola.

zh.s: 奥孙州于2018年9月22日举行州长选举。该次选举单独举行，而全国及州级选举原定于2019年举行。执政全体进步大会党两届州长劳夫·阿雷格贝索拉已无资格竞选连任。人民民主党候选人阿德莫拉·阿德莱克在初次投票中获胜，尼日利亚独立国家选举委员会（INEC）也宣布他当选；但9月27日重选后，他败给了戈耶加·奥耶托拉。

en.t: 2018 Green Party of Alberta leadership election
en.s: The 2018 Green Party of Alberta leadership election was spurred after Romy Tittel, who had won the leadership in 2017, resigned without explanation after five months as leader. The party later named Coral Bliss Taylor as interim leader. The winner of the election, Cheryle Chagnon-Greyeyes, was announced on September 22, 2018. She was the first Indigenous woman to lead a provincial party in Canada.

zh.s: 阿尔伯塔绿党2018年党魁选举是在罗米·蒂特尔无说明原因辞职后举行的。她于2017年当选党魁，任职仅5个月。该党随后任命科拉尔·布利斯·泰勒为临时党魁。谢丽尔·查尼翁-格雷耶斯当选，并于2018年9月22日公布结果；她是加拿大首位领导省级政党的原住民女性。

en.s: Regional elections were held on 22 September 2019 to determine the composition of the Legislative Assembly of the Autonomous Region of Madeira in Portugal. en.s: The election to the state parliament Landtag of Brandenburg was held on 22 September 2024. en.t: Anura Kumara Dissanayake is elected as the 9th President Of Sri Lanka
en.s: Anura Kumara Dissanayake (born 24 November 1968), commonly referred to by his initials AKD, is a Sri Lankan politician who has served as the president of Sri Lanka since 2024.
